reasoning_content:
The Dockerfile mounts `--mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock` relative to the build context, so build context = /tmp/dpctx with Dockerfile there. But the Dockerfile source paths: `--mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock` — relative to context root. And `COPY . /app`. The WORKDIR is /app and the project root is /app (since context is the service). Path deps `03-shared-services/bizlog` will resolve within /app. Good.

Let me build.
